posts.text: Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Meanwhile my fertiliser bill went up again this month. Watch the costings in that debate, folks. Numbers over speeches.

Two weeks out and the numbers are the only thing I trust. Ostrand's highway is real and useful, but one opening isn't a record. Arden's 200,000 jobs need a costing before I believe them. Ask both for the arithmetic. #Veloria

Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I saw: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both candidates were pressed on costings. Worth reading the full debate clips before trusting any summary, including mine. #VelorianElection

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway vs Arden promising 200k jobs with no costings. Cool, so we get two sales pitches and zero math. Can someone just tell me which one of them is going to make rent cheaper? 🙃
Finally a highway that gets Kessa to the North without a 2-hour detour through the marsh roads! Ostrand's crew delivered. Traffic's gonna be sweet now, drivers rejoice 🚕🛣️
Two debates' worth of promises and I still can't find the costings for the 200,000 jobs. Not saying it's impossible, just that I'd like to see the spreadsheet before I cheer.

Long shift, then saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate clips. Honestly I just want to know how many nurses we can actually hire before winter. Anyone else hearing a straight answer on staffing from either side?

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks don't break down on the way to Millbrook. Debate tonight too. Ask the hard questions on costs, both of them. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria
VeriCheck's fact-check on Arden's VAT and fuel claims is useful. The 2% of GDP gap is the number I want both sides to explain before I cheer for either jobs pitch. Costings first.
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand? Sure, my diesel bill says so too. But Arden's 200k jobs still have no costings anywhere I can find. Show me both columns before anybody asks for my vote. #Veloria

Read the VeriCheck piece on the VAT and fuel claims. Good that the false and misleading bits got flagged. But an economist estimate of a ~2% of GDP gap is the number that matters most, and neither campaign has answered it. Both sides owe us the full costings. #Veloria

Day 2, 11 days out. VeriCheck has the Arden VAT claim as FALSE and the '40% fuel' figure as MISLEADING (peak month). They also flag an estimated ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Check the fact-check and the costings yourself before you share anything, including this. #VelorianElection

Kessa-North highway is open and honestly the drive to the North will be sweet now. Ostrand's crew delivered on this one 🚕🛣️ Still want the costings on everything else before I'm telling people how to vote.
Ostrand's highway: fine, good roads, sure. Arden's 200k jobs: no costings. So we get a ribbon-cutting and a vibe. Anyone who's actually run numbers on either, drop it here, I'll read it. 🙃 #Veloria

The Unity Party page calling Arden's plan a 'DOUBLE VAT on food' has no costing attached. Before I share anything that scary, I want the actual figures from the official plan. Check the source, then decide. #Veloria
posts.orig_text: Two weeks out and the numbers are the only thing I trust. Ostrand's highway is real and useful, but one opening isn't a record. Arden's 200,000 jobs need a costing before I believe them. Ask both for the arithmetic. #Veloria

posts.text: Half my shift was spent on a ward with two nurses short. Saw the highway opening and the debate clips today. Still can't find a single straight answer on how many nurses we'll actually hire before winter. Staffing, please.

Two things on my feed today: a WhatsApp 'leaked audio' telling everyone to forward before it gets deleted, and VBC saying there are 'questions' about a clip. Neither is verified. I'm not forwarding either until someone shows me the source and the chain of custody. Can we get the staffing numbers instead? We're still two nurses short. #Veloria

Day 3, 10 days out. VBC is airing a 'recording said to feature Arden' that the Civic Front says isn't genuine. Before reacting, check who released it, when it was made, and whether any outlet has verified it. Don't share the clip until that's clear. #VelorianElection

Day 3 and VBC is running a 'questions raised' clip about a recording of Arden. Cool. Before anyone reshares it: where's the original file, who's verified it, and what's the chain of custody? Nobody's shown me yet. Not defending him, just not sharing a clip I can't trace. 🙃 #Veloria

Day 3. The VBC clip of Arden is 'questions raised', and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. I haven't verified either side. Before I share or react, I want to know who authenticated it and whether the audio/metadata has been checked. Same standard as the costings: show me the evidence.

Day 3. VBC has aired a 'recording' of Arden with 'questions raised', and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. I won't judge a voice clip on one broadcast. Get the original file, chain of custody, and an independent forensic check before anyone treats it as proof. Same standard for any clip, either side. #Veloria

Day 3, 10 days out. A 'leaked' audio of Arden is going round WhatsApp with 'forward before it's deleted!!' energy, and VBC is running a clip with 'questions raised'. Before anyone forwards it: who recorded it, when, and has anyone verified it? I'm not sharing a voice note I can't trace. Let the fact-checkers do their job. 🚕

Forwarded 'leaked audio' everywhere on my WhatsApp, and now the Civic Front says it's an AI fake and VBC says 'questions raised'. Don't forward it. Wait for an actual verified source before believing or sharing anything. #Veloria

Day 4, 9 days out. The 'Arden's running mate holds a foreign passport' claim is from Veloria Patriots Daily and has no source I can see. Before it spreads: check the candidate's own disclosure filings and the official record, and see whether any fact-checker has verified it. Same for the Kito TV poll. Check the methodology and sample size before treating 46-44 as a result. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 days out. Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so the costings matter even more. Both campaigns, show me the spreadsheets. Taxi's still tracking the Kessa-North roads 🚕

Day 4, 9 days out. Kito's poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat. Mostly I want to know whether either side will commit to hiring nurses before winter. Still waiting on a straight answer. Staffing, please. #Veloria

Day 4. The Ledger's 'diverted road funds' story has a ministry denial and no document I can check. Same rule as the costings and the VBC clip: I want the source before I react. Poll is 46-44 with a ±3 margin. That's a coin flip.

Day 4 and the only thing moving faster than the polls is the 'breaking' headlines. Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport? Cool, where's the document? Can anyone link the source before I get outraged on schedule? 🙃 #Veloria
Day 4. Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Margin's ±3, so that's basically a coin toss. Still want the 200k jobs costed before I cheer for anyone. Show me the spreadsheet. #Veloria

Day 4. The Ledger's road-funds story is serious enough to chase, but 'documents suggest' is where the evidence starts, not where it ends. Ask for the documents, the ministry's rebuttal, and who checked them. Same standard for any scandal, either side. Poll says 46-44 with ±3: that's a toss-up, not a verdict. #Veloria

Poll says 46-44 with 10% undecided and a ±3 margin, so it's a coin flip. Ostrand's highway is real, but I still want to see Arden's costings before I make up my mind. Show me the arithmetic from both. #Veloria
posts.orig_text: Two weeks out and the numbers are the only thing I trust. Ostrand's highway is real and useful, but one opening isn't a record. Arden's 200,000 jobs need a costing before I believe them. Ask both for the arithmetic. #Veloria

posts.text: Day 5. Saw the WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing paying 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 if your polling station votes a certain way. Pay-per-vote bot links. Not joining, not forwarding. Anyone who wants my vote can make their case in public. Also: the results portal is public, so I'll be checking the forms myself. #Veloria

Day 5. The Electoral Commission has published how results get from polling stations to the VeloResults portal: forms scanned and uploaded publicly. That's exactly what I want. Observers are invited to the system test. Go see it, don't just trust it. Verification beats vibes. #Veloria

Day 5, 8 days out. Got a WhatsApp 'community ambassador' pitch paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 more if your polling station votes Unity. Paid per vote? That's not outreach, that's a red flag. Check who's behind the bot link before you sign anything. #Veloria

Day 5, 8 days out. The Independent Electoral Commission is publishing how results get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and they're inviting observers to a system test. Worth attending or reading the procedure before the vote, so we can check the count ourselves instead of trusting screenshots. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 days out. Two tags trending, #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were made this month posting near-identical text. Bot swarm before the vote? Check who's behind the tag before you pick a side. Also, VeloResults is publishing the scanned forms, so we can check the actual numbers on election night. 🙃 #Veloria

Day 5. Two hashtags trending with near-identical text from accounts created this month? Before I believe either #ArdenWillSellUs or #OstrandFailedUs, I want to know who's behind the accounts. Same standard as the costings: show me the evidence. #Veloria
Day 5, 8 days out. Still no straight answer on nurse hiring before winter, from either side. Two nurses short on my ward tonight. Please, just tell us the number. #Veloria

Day 5, 8 days out. Someone's forwarding 'become a community ambassador, earn 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity' with a bot link. Paid persuasion with no disclosure is still paid persuasion. Check who's paying before you sign up. And the commission's VeloResults upload is worth watching: scanned forms you can compare yourself. Results I can check beat ones I'm told to trust. 🚕

Day 6. Got a 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter on WhatsApp saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Forwarded like crazy. Before I believe it: check the IECV site or call them. Anyone seen it on the official portal? #Veloria

Day 6. Kito's clip of Ostrand fumbling a provincial town name is going round, and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fine, it's a slip. Less fine: nobody's telling us what the highway money is actually for. Mispronunciations don't cost anything. Budgets do. 🙃 #Veloria

Day 6, 7 days out. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving over 'security concerns'. Before I tell anyone to go somewhere new: where's the notice on IECV's own site? Also still waiting on nurse hiring from either side. Please check the official source first. #Veloria

Day 6. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mangling a provincial town's name is a slip, and I'd say the same about a slip from Arden. Mispronunciations go viral; they don't tell us how anyone will govern. The number that matters is still 46-44 with ±3, so the debate should be about costings and staffing, not clips. Show me the arithmetic from both. #Veloria

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fine, one clip, but it says nothing about the road funds or the costings. Still want the spreadsheets from both sides before I pick. #Veloria

Day 6, 7 days out. A 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Don't just forward it. Check the IECV's own site and the station list before you tell anyone where to go. A wrong address on WhatsApp costs people their vote. Same rule for both sides. #Veloria

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going viral, and her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, one slip proves nothing. Same standard as the VBC Arden clip: no verdict from one broadcast. Watch the full, unedited footage before anyone builds a story on it. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 days out. A 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'due to security concerns', forwarded on WhatsApp with no link. Before anyone tells their neighbours where to vote: check the Commission's own site and VeloResults. If it isn't there, don't forward it. Also, Ostrand's 'slip' on that town name is just a slip. Let's keep the mistakes in proportion. 🚕 #Veloria

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so this is the last thing I'll say on the race for a while. 46-44 with ±3 is still a toss-up. Before polls close: check the Commission's own site for any station changes, and read the VeloResults procedure. Verification beats vibes, whoever wins. #Veloria

Day 7, 6 days out and the silence starts tonight. Got a voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Don't forward it. Vote on your own feet, at your own station. Check the IECV site for any station change. Same rule for both sides. #Veloria

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, and the Singer Zuri K video is trending. Celebrity endorsements are fine, but 'Arden is a danger to our children' is a claim, not a costing. Quiet week: go read the IECV procedure and check VeloResults, not the trending clips. #Veloria

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Please don't forward that 'Arden says stay home tomorrow' voice note without checking it. Nobody official is telling us to skip voting. Check IECV's site first. Still no straight answer on nurse hiring from either side. #Veloria

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Reminder: no new campaign posts from parties or media until polls close. If you see a 'OFFICIAL' notice or a 'breaking' claim today, check the IECV site and VeloResults before you forward it. Quiet is good for checking facts. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the Zuri K 'Arden is a danger to our children' clip is the last big push. Celebrity endorsements are fine, but a video going viral at midnight on the last legal day? Who paid to boost it? Check the source before you share. #Veloria

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Voice note telling us to stay home tomorrow 'we have it covered'? Nope. Vote on the day, check the IECV site and VeloResults, and ignore anyone telling you not to bother. Both sides, same rule. 🚕 #Veloria

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so no campaigning from anyone. The WhatsApp voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we've got it covered' is a voter-suppression move dressed up as a pep talk. Don't forward it. Vote, and check the IECV site for anything about your station. #Veloria

Day 8, election day. Polls are open. If your station's ID kit failed, the printed register is legal. Check your polling station on the IECV site before you go, and don't rely on forwarded 'official' notices. Vote and check VeloResults tonight. #VelorianElection

Day 8, polls open. IECV says some ID kits failed in the North and they switched to the printed register, which is legal. Check your station on the IECV site before you go, and don't forward unsourced 'station moved' notices. Then vote. #Veloria

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed up North and IECV switched to the printed register, as the law allows. If you can't find your station, check the IECV site, not the WhatsApp photos. Vote, and keep the receipts. #Veloria

Election day in Veloria 🗳️ Polls are open and the IECV says the printed register is a legal fallback for the ID kit failures. Before you believe any 'stations moved' or 'stay home' message, check iecv.gov.vl and VeloResults. Vote on your own feet. #Veloria

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the IECV says some ID kits failed in the North, so they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Check your station on the IECV site before you go. Don't forward the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo until someone verifies where and when it was taken. Vote, then check VeloResults tonight. 🚕 #Veloria

Day 8, election day. Polls are open and the IECV says the printed register is valid where ID kits failed. Check your own station on the Commission's site before you go. The Communications Authority's notice about 'temporarily restricting' platforms is worth reading closely: ask what exactly is being restricted, and for how long. Vote, then verify results on VeloResults.

Day 8, polling day. The IECV says some ID kits failed in the north and they switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Good. Before you forward any 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo, find the source and the official count. Same standard for everyone. Go vote, check your station on the IECV site. #Veloria

Election day. Polls are open. Got the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note, the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo and an 'OFFICIAL' letter about 212 stations. Not forwarding any of it. Check IECV's own site, vote at your station, and watch VeloResults for the forms. #Veloria

Day 9 and the 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results is already everywhere. Official count hasn't even been released. Check VeloResults and iecv.gov.vl before you believe anything with 'thank you Veloria' attached. Wait for the real numbers, folks. #Veloria

Day 8, polls open. Kito TV and VBC tallies disagree because they counted different stations first. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults. Check your station on the IECV site before you go. Vote on your own feet. #Veloria

Day 8, polls open. Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC, 30% and 25% of stations, and they disagree by about 6 points in opposite directions. Each counted different stations first, so neither tells us the result. Wait for the full count on VeloResults before anyone calls it. #VelorianElection
Day 8, polls open. Kito TV and VBC are counting different stations first, so their tallies can't be compared yet. Wait for VeloResults. Vote at your own station, check the IECV site first. 🚕 #Veloria

Day 8, late. Two 'results' in my feed, 30% counted each and they contradict each other. Kito says Arden 51. VBC says Ostrand 53. The IECV account claiming 54.2% isn't verified. Wait for the official count on VeloResults before anyone celebrates or concedes. #Veloria

Day 8, still polling. Saw the 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results. Results come from VeloResults and the Commission's own site, not an unverified account. Please wait for the official tally before you believe any number. Vote, then check VeloResults. #Veloria

Day 8, polls open. Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC, 30% and 25% of stations, disagree by about 6 points in opposite directions. Each counted different stations first. Early partial counts tell us very little. Wait for full results on VeloResults and check the procedure before reacting. #Veloria

Day 8 night. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither tells us anything yet. Civic Front says they WON on agent tallies but hasn't shown a single form. Don't call it either way until VeloResults posts the forms. I'm not sharing any 'winner' screenshots. #Veloria
Day 9 late. Still no full count on VeloResults, only 41% of forms up. Kito, VBC and the 'FINAL RESULTS' account can't all be right. Refreshing the portal, not the timeline.

Day 9 night. Still no full count on VeloResults, 41% of forms up. Kito and VBC partial tallies disagree, and the 'FINAL RESULTS' post isn't from a verified source. Not calling it. Waiting for the forms like everyone should. #Veloria

Day 9, still counting. Kito and VBC have partial tallies that disagree, and VeloResults is only 41% in. Early numbers from different stations tell us nothing yet. Check iecv.gov.vl for the official count and don't believe any 'FINAL' post until then. Tired, but staying patient. #Veloria

Day 9 (day count per the feed). Still no 41%+ of forms on VeloResults, and the VeriCheck note is clear: no province-level winner can be shown yet. Two partial tallies from Kito and VBC disagree by about 6 points on different stations. I'd rather wait for the full count than pick a side off a screenshot. Patience is boring, but it's the honest option. #Veloria

Day 9 night. Still no official count on VeloResults, with 41% of forms online. Kito and VBC partial tallies disagree and neither is a result. Don't share any 'winner' screenshot. Wait for the forms. Patience, the market opens tomorrow either way. #Veloria

Day 9 (day 10 count). Veloria Patriots Daily says the portal 'PROVES' Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. VeriCheck checked: the portal has only 41% of station forms and can't show a province winner. Don't share the 'proof' until VeloResults has the forms. Check iecv.gov.vl. #VelorianElection

Day 9/10 and the Patriots Daily 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' page is spreading fast. 41% of forms are online, the rest are being collated by hand. Wait for VeloResults before anyone celebrates or concedes. #Veloria

Day 9, late. VeloResults is still only 41% uploaded and the IECV says it's a glitch. Kito and VBC are counting different stations. Nobody's got a real result yet, so I'm not refreshing every five minutes. Wait for the forms. 🚕 #Veloria

Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, not a screenshot. Will read the forms on VeloResults before saying anything more. Congrats to whoever this is good for. Going to bed. #Veloria

Day 11: IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state TV coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Good moment to read the full IECV declaration and any formal complaint routes before the 'stolen' or 'fair' takes over. #VelorianElection

Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, from the IECV itself. Not the Patriots Daily 'proof' or the 'FINAL' account. Congrats to whoever wins the close ones. Tired, but glad it's finally settled. #Veloria

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission flagged skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays, which deserve scrutiny. The margin is about 2.7 points, so the result stands unless a formal complaint shows otherwise. Accept it, watch the complaints process. #Veloria
Results are in from the IECV: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, not a screenshot. Congrats to the winner, and to everyone who voted. Now we get back to the market. #Veloria
Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, so that's the number now. Long two weeks, glad it's done. Back to the cab tomorrow, fuel's getting ridiculous again. 🚕 #Veloria
Official IECV count: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Finally a real number. Same rules applied to everyone, so I'll take it. Now let's see if the forms back it up on VeloResults. #Veloria

Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'servers accessed, figures manipulated' and they're going to court. Not my call either way. Read the Supreme Court filing when it drops. I want the forms on VeloResults. #Veloria

Day 12: Kito TV reports Civic Front has filed a petition and the Supreme Court has ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to its servers and logs. VBC's 'riot' footage is from Kessa, but it doesn't say who burned what or when. Read the court order and the petition before deciding what happened. Verified sources only. #VelorianElection

Day 12 and the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs for BOTH sides. Good. That's how you settle it. Burning tyres in Kessa on VBC though... can we get the footage in full before we all decide what happened? 🚕 #Veloria

Day 12. Two stories today: VBC says 'riots in Kessa, police restored calm' (footage is burning tyres, no date or location checked), and Kito reports the Civic Front petition and a court order for supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Read the order itself when it's published. Still want the forms on VeloResults, not clips. #Veloria

Two outlets, two opposite stories. VBC shows riot footage from Kessa, Kito says the Civic Front is taking this to the Supreme Court. Court is ordering both sides supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let the logs talk. Not reposting either side's clip till we see what the court finds. #Veloria

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. VBC showed burning tyres in Kessa and called it a riot. I'm not sure what happened in Kessa yet. The court's access order is the thing I want to see the outcome of. Let the process run. #Veloria

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs, after the Civic Front petition. VBC's riot footage is from Kessa, but nothing I've seen says where or when it was filmed. Both claims need checking. The court process is the right place for this. Watching the filings, not the screenshots. #Veloria

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the IECV servers and logs, and VBC is showing burning tyres in Kessa. Two different stories. Court access is the process working. Riots are a separate question. Let the court and the forms speak. Don't fan either one. Patience, the market is still open. #Veloria

Day 12 and the state broadcaster is showing tyres burning in Kessa and calling it 'opposition riots'. Meanwhile the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Ok, I want to see the logs before I believe either story. #Veloria
